title: deferred-capacity-orchestrator-and-commitment-replay-adapter
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We observed oscillatory scaling during rapid tenant commit churn where short-lived commitments trigger immediate provisioning and then decommit shortly after, causing thrashing and elevated unit costs. This PR introduces a Deferred Capacity Orchestrator (DCO) plus a Commitment Replay Adapter (CRA) that treats recent commitment events as an event stream and replays them into a smoothed planning window to produce less reactive provision decisions.

Summary: Implement an event-sourced replay layer that ingests reservation/commit events (create/extend/release) and emits aggregated delta plans on a configurable horizon. The DCO uses those plans with temporal damping and a cost-weighted headroom objective to decide elastic provisioning actions. The CRA translates legacy commitment records into the event stream so existing commitment writers do not need modification.

What changed (high level): - New event ingestion pipeline and small in-memory event journal (bounded retention). - Commitment Replay Adapter that serializes/deserializes legacy commitment records and emits normalized events. - Deferred Capacity Orchestrator that consumes the replay stream and outputs provision intents (scaleUp/scaleDown) with an adjustable lookahead and hysteresis. - Telemetry: new metrics for replay_lag_seconds, plan_variance, and predicted_headroom. - Tests: unit + integration harness that simulates bursty commit patterns and validates stability and cost regressions versus current autoscaler. - Docs: design doc and operator runbook describing tuning knobs and operational alerts.

Behavioral notes: The orchestrator will not immediately act on single short-lived commits unless the replay window indicates sustained contention above tenant SLO thresholds. The controller respects existing reservation priorities and burst credits; it produces intents that the existing provisioning reconciler will consume.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc added (docs/design/deferred_capacity.md) - [x] Unit tests for replay adapter and orchestrator decision logic - [x] Integration scenario harness and golden baseline comparison - [x] Metrics and dashboard snippets for ops - [x] Backwards-compatible adapter for older commitment writers

Migration/compatibility: CRA runs side-by-side and can be toggled per-cluster via a feature flag. No database schema changes required. Operators should enable the replay journal and monitor replay_lag_seconds during the first 24h.

Related work: builds on autoscaler research (ENG-4721) and ties into tenant budgeting improvements (ENG-4888). See docs/design for decision formulas and examples.

Detailed commit summary: see commits field.

Files changed (high level): see changed_files field.

Testing: Local unit tests and the integration harness were run; we also deployed a canary to the staging fleet for 48h under synthetic churn and saw a 23% reduction in ephemeral provisioning events and ~7% lower GPU-hour cost for the scenario used in the harness.

Operational concerns: Operators should watch plan_variance and predicted_headroom. If plan_variance spikes it indicates noisy commit traffic and operators can increase damping or widen the replay horizon.
